intervention: Train a fresh Transformer from the identical initialization in all three arms, retaining the pretrained frozen acoustic encoder. Student always uses BCE+uniform KL. Uniform candidate sampling, random phone emphasis, or REINFORCE-learned phone emphasis. ALL available phone features remain in every student input and at inference. No inference-time selector.
sampling: Group source schedule rows 0:32000 four at a time into 128-query candidate pools. Preserve paired genuine/impostor trials and existing negatives. Select 32 candidate positions without replacement by exponential keys, independently within each corpus. Match corpus quotas to the first source row in each pool. An action upweights pairs with a shared target phone by 4x; uniform is also an action. Include every nonconstant phone over the frozen training pools. Five vowels are constant under original eligibility and cannot change sampling. Shared keys and per-update dropout seeds couple all branches.
teacher: Linear categorical policy with context [1, progress, current reward macro EER], initialized uniformly; 20% uniform exploration. Every 100 student updates, sample two independent actions from the pre-update policy. Fork student AND AdamW state for each action and a uniform control; use identical candidate pools, update counts and dropout seeds. Reward is uniform-control EER minus action-branch EER on the fixed reward set. Update teacher by mean REINFORCE plus uniform KL. ALWAYS continue the first sampled branch, even when reward is negative; never pick the best branch. Cache duplicate actions only because branch training is deterministic.
partition: Deterministically split old validation speakers by hash into floor(N/2) reward and remaining selection speakers per corpus. Keep only trials whose query AND claimed speaker belong to that partition. Reward data train the teacher and are NOT independent validation. Selection speakers choose student checkpoints and FAR1% thresholds; test speakers never give rewards. All source train/reward/selection/test speaker sets are disjoint.
selection: Evaluate all available phones on selection speakers every 1000 updates including zero. Earliest minimum equal-corpus normal-sentence EER. Freeze selected/final models and selection FAR1% thresholds before new test inference. Report fixed 8000-update endpoint separately.
limits: Initial-learning pilot, not a replacement comparison against the existing 64k model. One initialization/teacher seed per three acoustic seeds. One-block contextual-bandit rewards do not optimize full delayed returns or guarantee global optimum. Teacher changes data distribution, not total committed student updates; counterfactual probes add compute. Reward and selection speaker pools are small and all test data were previously observed. No new recordings or change to adopted data.
